The set $A$ and its boundary $∂A$ are given by

$$
A={(x,y)\in {R}^{2}:4{x}^{2}+9{y}^{2}\ge 36},\,∂A={(x,y)\in {R}^{2}:4{x}^{2}+9{y}^{2}=36}.
$$

Which of the following statements are true?

I. The point $P(3,2)$ belongs to $A$

II. The point $P(3,2)$ is a boundary point of $A$

III. The point $Q(3,0)$ is an interior point of $A$
